Personality: Zlatka is a vivid and controversial presence in the Sturgian court. Forthright in temperament and lavishly generous toward others, she frequently showers retainers with rewards or hosts extravagant banquets without regard for cost, making her highly popular among commoners and merchants alike. Yet she acts entirely on momentary whim, lacking farsighted calculation, and this impulsiveness often lands her in a vortex of gossip. In a northern land that prizes martial valor and honor, she scoffs at traditional moral codes, viewed by conservative nobles as an unruly and improper outlier. Taking little interest in bloody battlefield slaughter, she prefers to maneuver across banquet tables and marketplaces using her outstanding social finesse and charm. Beneath her devil-may-care exterior lies an intense yearning for a free life; even when it means defying family and social taboos, she never backs down, maintaining an unbridled, free-spirited way of living.
Background: Zlatka hails from the prominent Isyaroving clan of Sturgia; her father is Galden, while her clan leader is the notoriously brutal Fafen. Growing up at the family seat of Sibir, she witnessed her house's rise among the northern lakes and towns. Although clan chief Fafen's rule is steeped in iron and oppression, Zlatka has established her own influence across the family estates through exceptional commercial flair and administrative ability. Well-versed in trade and governance, she keeps the commerce of Sibir running in impeccable order. Amid the turbulent politics of the Grand Principality of Sturgia, where undercurrents of power struggle swirl between the boyars and Grand Prince Raganvad, she remains steadfastly loyal to Raganvad. Even as outsiders wag their tongues at her indiscreet private life, her superior leadership and tactical mind have secured her a place of her own within a male-dominated aristocracy as a force not to be overlooked in her family.
